blurb: Guests join dolphin tours aboard the 70-foot Sea Racer, cruising through the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic Ocean near Myrtle Beach and Little River. Tours offer opportunities to see Atlantic bottlenose dolphins and other marine life in their natural habitat. The experience includes narration by the captain and photo opportunities.

quotes.text: Very nice captains and know you are in good hands out there! Saw tons of dolphins! Boat is very nice. Don’t sit in back if don’t want to get wet lol. The only downside for me was we spent like half hour by dolphins and I love them but was hoping for more boat ride. Only short ride in ocean and boat was rocking lot while sitting i did feel fine then you come back in again. I still recommend doing.

Booked the dolphin cruise for 12 of my family members while we were on a vacation and couldn’t have asked for a better day. The crew was amazing, did everything they could to shift gears to find the dolphins and ended up seeing one of the best feeding pods. 100% worth the price! Kids haven’t stopped talking about it

The 10 am boat ride was great. Yes it was choppy. Yes it rained a bit. Yes we got a little ocean spray on us. Yes the guys were great and informative. No we did not see dolphins. No we do not care. We had a great relaxing 1½ hour ride. We'd definitely go again.

Emily and the Captain were just fantastic. What a great experience. We started with a sullen teenager and a scared little one and bioth were thrilled five minutes in. Highly recommend the tour for locals and tourists alike.

I couldn't be more satisfied with our tour with Captains Terry and Emily. The ride itself was amazing, the view and we seen dolphins. Very professional, I highly recommend and I will be back next year
What a fun boat ride! Billy and Terry were so fun and informative! The dolphins showed up today and danced and swam along our boat ride. An unforgettable time! Thank you for an excellent experience!!
